source_units: Free Dialogue Cleanup for Voice and Post

is a free dialogue cleanup plug-in for voice and post-production workflows. Separate sibilance and residual processing let you improve clarity and consistency without forcing every voice problem through one broad control.
Dialogue Doctor is still in active development.
The release has been postponed while we continue refining it, but it has not been cancelled and we remain committed to releasing it. Thank you for your patience—please stay tuned.
Independently control sibilance and residual cleanup.
Improve dialogue clarity while keeping a natural tone.
Keep speech consistent across takes and scenes.
The level above which high-frequency content is treated as sibilance.
Ignores very quiet signals below this level to prevent false detection.
Minimum event length required before processing starts.
How quickly detection fades after sibilance drops.
Pre-scans incoming audio to catch fast sibilants more accurately.
Controls how quickly the detector follows waveform changes.
Lower bound of the processing frequency range.
Upper bound of the processing frequency range.
Tightens or broadens emphasis inside the selected band.
Maximum amount of attenuation applied to harsh content.
Overall intensity of the harshness reduction.
Primary frequency region used for click detection.
Detection aggressiveness for short click artifacts.
Longest transient duration treated as a click.
Balances smooth repair vs. preserved detail.
During declicking, repair prioritizes continuity of the surrounding waveform contour over spectral replacement. This minimizes timbral change and favors a natural result.
Wet/dry blend between processed and original signal.
With Contour Priority ON, processing leans toward continuous contour repair, so Max Len has less impact.
Time window used to suppress plosive events.
Reduction depth applied to detected plosives.
Quick polish for noisy or inconsistent dialogue across takes.
Keep narration clear and present while staying natural.
Separate sibilance and residual control across speakers.

Dialogue Doctor is not currently available for download. Development is continuing, and the release has been postponed while the plug-in is refined. It has not been cancelled, and we remain committed to releasing it. Installation details will be published when the release is ready.
